description: Absolute bounds on the quality metrics (evals/metrics.py). A critical breach fails the harness run, and with it CI; any other breach is a warning in the report. Critical bounds are safety properties and hold for every model configuration; the rest are targets, and a weak model is expected to miss some of them. Per-domain bounds (`<metric>_<domain>`) apply to each domain the Supervisor routes to; a domain with no cases for a metric reports `n/a`, which a critical bound treats as a breach -- so a new domain must ship with golden cases, not just a floor. Change a bound in review, never to make a run pass.
